description: Common interface states with explicit facts, permissions, and recovery boundaries.

cases.context: 账号邀请表单。邮箱字段未通过客户端格式校验，表单尚未提交到服务器，用户可以修改该字段。

inputCopy.text: 前端 schema validation failed: email_invalid
修复后进入下一验收步骤

verifiedFacts: 用户可以编辑邮箱字段
mustPreservePropositions: 明确指出邮箱格式问题
mustRemoveIntents: 暴露 schema、错误代码或验收步骤
mustNotInfer: 邮箱不存在、已被占用或被服务器拒绝
邀请已发送或账号已创建
layoutConstraints: 错误信息与邮箱字段关联
适合字段下方一到两行显示
cases.rationale: 字段错误应说明用户能修正的事实，不能把客户端校验说成服务器结果。

cases.context: A report export runs on the server and continues if the user leaves the page. There is no progress estimate and no cancel control.

inputCopy.text: Please keep this window open while the worker completes.

verifiedFacts: The report export is being prepared
It continues on the server after navigation
mustPreservePropositions: The export is still being prepared
mustRemoveIntents: Expose pipeline and worker implementation language
Tell the user to keep the window open
mustNotInfer: A completion time or percentage
A cancel, background notification, or download action
That leaving the page stops the export
layoutConstraints: The status region must remain concise and stable while polling
cases.rationale: Loading copy should state the true asynchronous condition without inventing progress or unnecessary instructions.

cases.context: 保存设置时请求超时。服务器没有确认写入，页面保留用户输入，并提供重新保存按钮。
verifiedFacts: 服务器没有确认设置是否写入
用户输入仍保留在页面
mustPreservePropositions: 不能声称保存成功或失败
mustRemoveIntents: 暴露 mutation 或提交链路实现语言
使用含义不明的继续按钮
mustNotInfer: 设置一定没有写入或已经写入
超时的根因
刷新页面可以解决问题
layoutConstraints: 错误提示和重新保存按钮应在同一状态区域
cases.rationale: 超时是一种未知结果，文案必须保留不确定性并只提供真实的恢复动作。

cases.context: A completed contact import created 23 records and skipped 2 duplicate rows. The user can open the import report.
mustNotInfer: All rows were imported
Skipped rows were invalid or deleted
The import changed any existing record
layoutConstraints: Both counts remain visible in the success state
cases.rationale: Success copy must not hide partial outcomes behind a generic success claim.

cases.context: 报表页的已保存筛选区域为空。用户有创建筛选权限，页面提供创建按钮。

inputCopy.text: 空状态目标：引导用户建立留存习惯

verifiedFacts: 当前没有已保存的筛选
mustPreservePropositions: 为空的是已保存筛选，而不是报表数据
mustRemoveIntents: 暴露留存目标或用户引导策略
使用与实际动作无关的探索话术
mustNotInfer: 报表没有数据
系统会自动保存筛选
已有推荐筛选
layoutConstraints: 空状态只保留一个主动作
cases.rationale: 空状态需要准确指出缺少的对象，并把按钮映射到真实创建动作。

cases.context: A confirmation dialog deletes 3 draft automation rules permanently. Published rules are not affected. Delete and Cancel are the only controls.

inputCopy.text: Proceed with cleanup? This action affects selected candidates.

verifiedFacts: Exactly 3 draft automation rules will be deleted
mustRemoveIntents: Use mutation, cleanup, or candidate as unexplained implementation language
mustNotInfer: Published rules or other drafts will be deleted
Deleted rules can be restored
Any action beyond Delete and Cancel
layoutConstraints: The destructive button includes the object and count
The warning remains visible before confirmation
cases.rationale: Destructive confirmation copy must identify scope and consequence precisely.

cases.context: 分析看板。当前用户可以查看数据，但没有导出权限；页面提供向工作区管理员申请导出权限的入口。
verifiedFacts: 当前用户可以查看看板数据
当前用户没有导出权限
用户可以向工作区管理员申请导出权限
mustPreservePropositions: 限制只涉及导出，不影响查看
mustRemoveIntents: 暴露 RBAC gate 等实现语言
把申请权限包装成解锁功能
mustNotInfer: 管理员一定会批准
申请后立即获得权限
用户需要付费升级
layoutConstraints: 权限说明与申请按钮相邻
cases.rationale: 权限文案要说明当前仍可做什么、受限动作和真实申请路径。

cases.context: An archived project detail page. Archived projects can be viewed but not edited. The user can open project history; restore and duplicate controls do not exist.

inputCopy.text: Mutation controls disabled by lifecycle state

verifiedFacts: It can be viewed but not edited
mustPreservePropositions: The project is archived and read-only
mustRemoveIntents: Expose mutation-control or lifecycle implementation language
mustNotInfer: The project can be restored, duplicated, or edited
The project was archived by the current user
Archived data will be deleted
layoutConstraints: The archived status remains visible near the project title
cases.rationale: Read-only copy must make the limitation explicit without inventing a route out of it.

cases.context: 连接状态横幅。服务计划维护到 03:00，客户端会自动重新连接；当前页面没有重试、状态页或联系支持入口。

inputCopy.text: 维护态兜底：建立用户信心并承接下一步

verifiedFacts: 客户端会自动重新连接
页面没有用户可执行的恢复动作
mustRemoveIntents: 暴露建立信心或承接下一步的文案策略
显示不存在的立即重试动作
mustNotInfer: 维护会提前结束
用户可以重试、查看状态页或联系支持
自动重新连接一定在 03:00 瞬间成功
layoutConstraints: 横幅不能因不存在的按钮预留交互位置
时间在窄屏上保持完整
cases.rationale: 没有动作时应诚实说明状态和系统行为，不能为了页面模式补一个 CTA。
